requirements.title: POPCNT counts one bits
requirements.definition: The POPCNT result equals the number of one bits in the integer bit sequence of I.

pending.POPCNT-zero-has-zero-one-bits: Initialize a result sentinel to -1, assert POPCNT(0)==0, and pair with POPCNT(IBSET(0,0))==1 so the zero result is not vacuous.
pending.POPCNT-counts-multiple-set-bits: Construct an integer with bits 0, 2, and 5 set using IBSET from zero; assert POPCNT returns 3 and mutate one IBSET position.
pending.POPCNT-distinguishes-different-bit-count: Use companion values with one, two, and three set bits and assert distinct counts; mutate POPCNT to POPPAR or drop one bit-setting operation.
